ETS‑Lindgren to Showcase Innovative Solutions at 2026 IEEE EMC Society Tabletop Shows
 April 24, 2026
CEDAR PARK, Texas, April 24, 2026 – ETS‑Lindgren, the global leader in Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Radio Frequency (RF) Measurement Solutions, is pleased to announce its participation in two upcoming industry tabletop events: the Chicago IEEE EMC MiniSymposium and EMC Fest 2026 .
The 33rd Annual Chicago IEEE EMC MiniSymposium, hosted by the IEEE EMC Society Chicago Chapter, will take place on Tuesday, May 5, at the Embassy Suites in Naperville, Illinois, and will provide a valuable opportunity for industry professionals to learn about the latest developments in EMC technology. ETS‑Lindgren’s Trusted Advisors will be onsite to share insights and demonstrate solutions designed to support EMC test and measurement applications. Attendees will also be able to peruse the Test and Measurement Solutions Full Line Brochure to learn about our comprehensive customizable products and services.
The IEEE EMC Society Southeastern Michigan Chapter’s EMC Fest 2026 will be held on Thursday, May 7, at the Embassy Suites in Livonia, Michigan. ETS‑Lindgren will showcase its Top 10 Considerations for Automotive EMC Chamber Design and Testing Brochure, along with its Test and Measurement Solutions Full Line Brochure. These resources highlight the company’s expertise in automotive EMC testing, providing industry professionals with guidance on designing chambers and improving test efficiency.
Both events will feature speakers:
Dan Beeker, President and CTO with System Solution Specialists, who will present “Controlling the Waves: A Field-based Perspective on High-speed PCB Design.”
Chris Semanson, Staff Power Systems Applications Engineer with Renesas Electronics America Inc., will give a demonstration on building a practical framework to use on the bench and in the chamber followed by a talk covering near-field versus far-field coupling.
“We look forward to participating in the IEEE EMC MiniSymposium and EMC Fest 2026, where we will have the opportunity to connect with industry professionals and share practical solutions for EMC challenges,” said Kevin Baldwin, Director of Regional Sales with ETS‑Lindgren. “These events provide an excellent platform for discussing the latest advancements in EMC technology and supporting the efforts of the IEEE EMC Society Chicago and Southeastern Michigan Chapters.”
Participants at both events are encouraged to visit the tabletop displays to learn more about how ETS‑Lindgren’s EMC and Automotive EMC Solutions can benefit their companies.
About ETS‑Lindgren
ETS‑Lindgren is an international manufacturer of components and systems that measure, shield, and control electromagnetic energy. The company’s products are used for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), microwave, wireless, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) testing, electromagnetic field (EMF) measurement, and radio frequency (RF) personal safety monitoring.
Headquartered in Cedar Park, Texas, ETS‑Lindgren has manufacturing facilities in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of ESCO Technologies, a leading supplier of engineered products for growing industrial and commercial markets. ESCO is a New York Stock Exchange listed company (symbol ESE) with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Additional information about ETS‑Lindgren is available at www.ets-lindgren.com. Follow ETS‑Lindgren on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube. Additional information about ESCO and its subsidiaries is available at www.escotechnologies.com.

 Healthcare 
ETS‑Lindgren delivers advanced healthcare solutions that integrate electromagnetic shielding, EMC testing, and RF interference mitigation to enhance medical device performance, ensure patient safety, and support the development of compliant, next-generation healthcare technologies.
ETS‑Lindgren provides specialized healthcare solutions that enhance medical device equipment performance, patient safety, and clinical testing environments. With extensive expertise in electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) and radio frequency (RF) shielding, the company offers specialized solutions for MRI shielding, medical EMC testing, and secure environments for sensitive healthcare technologies. Our advanced shielding solutions ensure MRI suites are free from electromagnetic interference, allowing for precise imaging while protecting surrounding equipment from RF emissions.
Beyond MRI shielding, ETS‑Lindgren supports the medical industry with EMC test systems that ensure compliance with regulatory standards for medical devices. Our turnkey EMC solutions help manufacturers validate the safety and reliability of life-saving medical technologies, ensuring they function properly in electromagnetic environments. These test systems facilitate faster product development cycles while maintaining compliance with FDA, IEC, and other global standards.

 General Purpose Shielding 
Hospitals and imaging facilities rely on RF shielding to protect sensitive medical equipment from interference. ETS‑Lindgren designs shielded rooms and components that ensure stable operation of diagnostic and treatment systems.
ETS‑Lindgren offers specialized general-purpose shielding solutions designed to meet the unique requirements of a variety of medical applications, including EEG (electroencephalography), EKG/ECG (electrocardiography), MCG (magnetocardiography), MEG (magnetoencephalography), and mammography. These applications require precise and sensitive measurements, and ETS‑Lindgren’s shielding solutions effectively protect against electromagnetic interference (EMI), ensuring the accuracy of readings and patient care. Our RF shielding products, including enclosures, barriers, and doors, are tailored to create controlled environments where external interference is minimized, allowing for reliable diagnostic results.
For EEG, EKG, and ECG applications, ETS‑Lindgren’s shielding solutions prevent noise from impacting the electrical signals being measured, enhancing the clarity of heart and brain activity data. Similarly, in MCG and MEG, where the detection of extremely weak magnetic fields is crucial, our shielding ensures that ambient electromagnetic fields do not distort critical measurements. For mammography, our shielding systems prevent interference that could potentially affect imaging quality, ensuring precise and high-resolution diagnostic images. Overall, ETS‑Lindgren’s shielding solutions help healthcare facilities deliver accurate, reliable, and safe medical diagnostics across a range of sensitive testing environments.

 MRI Shielding 
ETS‑Lindgren is the world’s leading provider of MRI RF and magnetic shielding solutions. Shielded rooms, doors, windows, and magnetic compensation systems preserve image quality and protect patients and staff.
ETS‑Lindgren offers a comprehensive line of MRI solutions with a strong focus on advanced shielding technologies tailored for MRI environments, including interventional MRI suites and intra-operative suites. The company’s RF shielding systems, which include RF shielded enclosures, doors, windows, and interfacing MEP connections, are specifically designed to protect MRI machines and surrounding areas from electromagnetic interference (EMI), ensuring clean and accurate imaging. These systems also maintain a clean environment for both patients and medical staff by preventing external RF signals from contaminating MRI data while ensuring compliance with safety standards.
In addition to shielding, ETS‑Lindgren provides a variety of MRI accessories that enhance both patient safety and the performance of MRI systems. Our patient screening devices are designed to prevent the introduction of ferrous objects into MRI rooms, reducing the risk of injury. ETS‑Lindgren also offers MRI-compatible LED lighting systems, which provide optimal illumination without interfering with sensitive imaging equipment. Furthermore, our magnetic active compensation systems correct residual magnetic fields in the MRI suite, optimizing imaging accuracy and quality.
Another critical aspect of ETS‑Lindgren’s MRI solutions is our oxygen monitoring systems, which track oxygen levels in MRI suites, ensuring a safe and controlled environment, especially in interventional and intra-operative settings. These integrated solutions work together to create a secure, efficient, and reliable MRI environment, enhancing the overall patient experience and ensuring the highest quality of clinical outcomes. By combining advanced shielding with a wide array of safety and performance-enhancing accessories, ETS‑Lindgren supports healthcare professionals in delivering superior care.

 RF Microwave/Antenna Pattern Measurement 
ETS‑Lindgren provides industry-leading RF microwave and antenna measurement solutions—ranging from anechoic chambers to fully integrated test systems—that deliver precise, reliable testing for wireless, aerospace, defense, and automotive applications, backed by decades of expertise and end-to-end support.
At ETS‑Lindgren, we offer industry-leading RF microwave and antenna pattern measurement solutions designed to support a wide range of applications, including wireless communications, aerospace, defense, and automotive industries. Our advanced measurement systems provide precise and reliable testing environments for characterizing antenna performance, ensuring compliance with industry standards, and optimizing system efficiency. With a comprehensive portfolio that includes anechoic chambers, compact ranges, and open-area test sites, we deliver customized solutions to meet the specific needs of our customers.
Our capabilities extend to high-frequency microwave testing, featuring state-of-the-art absorber materials, chamber design and installation, positioners, and automated measurement systems that enhance accuracy and repeatability. We integrate advanced technology to support passive and active antenna testing, over-the-air (OTA) measurements, and full-system evaluations. Our turnkey solutions also include software integration for seamless data acquisition, processing, and analysis, providing customers with a streamlined testing workflow.
With decades of expertise in RF and microwave measurement solutions, ETS‑Lindgren is committed to delivering high-performance testing environments that meet the evolving demands of modern communication and radar systems. From initial design consultation to installation, calibration, and ongoing support, we ensure that our customers receive robust, future-proof solutions tailored to their unique testing requirements.
